subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped allowFrom replace the root allowlist, as current docs/tests say, or should root and account allowFrom be unioned for inbound DMs?
rationale: The obvious union repair may fix one reported failure mode but broadens who can start DM agent sessions for accounts that currently narrow root access.

options.title: Preserve account narrowing
options.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as the default narrowing boundary and improve diagnostics/setup guidance for DMs that hit the wrong account or missing account allowlist.

options.title: Union root and account lists
options.body: Allow root-listed users through account DMs too, but document and test the broader authorization semantics as an intentional compatibility break.

options.title: Add an explicit opt-in mode
options.body: Keep current default semantics and add a documented account-level inheritance/union switch only if maintainers want both behaviors.

recommendation.title: Preserve account narrowing
recommendation.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as the default narrowing boundary and improve diagnostics/setup guidance for DMs that hit the wrong account or missing account allowlist.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits in the shared DM allowlist and Discord account config path where current blame and recent feature history point most strongly to steipete.
